items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Elvis was my big hero, Elvis Presley.

ctx.x: What do you remember of your earliest musical experiences, things you heard on the radio, or live, or whatever.?

Rock-and-roll. I loved – I don’t know if I heard Rock Around the Clock when it came out, but I was there certainly pretty close to the beginning. And Elvis was my big hero, Elvis Presley. Even I used to sing, when I was on crutches – because I had the polio thing, which I’m sure we’ll get to eventually – I would take the crutch, like a guitar, stand in front of the mirror, and think I was Elvis. I sang Hound Dog, Don’t Be Cruel, Heartbreak Hotel. I loved Elvis Presley. So I was – the first musical experience,…
When Bill Haley and Elvis came on the scene, you would have been about 9 or 10. So that makes sense.
